name: spawnpoint
description: A store for AI-made browser games, running on Cloudflare Workers, D1 and R2.

DB.description: Database for game listings, versions and ratings.

FILES.description: Storage for uploaded game files and cover images.

ADMIN_KEY.description: A long password you choose. It lets you remove any game as the site owner. Keep it private.

NEW_GAMES_PER_DAY.description: How many new games one person can publish per day.

MAX_GAME_MB.description: Largest game upload allowed, in MB.
